args.title: Respect quality values (q=) in locale parsing
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The function pickLocale needs to parse and respect the quality values (q= weights) in the Accept-Language header. Currently, it just picks the first supported language prefix, ignoring q values, which leads to incorrect locale selection. This change will make the API respond according to the best locale based on q values.
